subject: organic
question:
有机化学·区域选择性（Reactivity Learn 改编）：底物 2-Methylcyclohexanone，试剂及条件 LDA, THF, −78 °C。优先从哪个 α-碳去质子化形成烯醇盐？（请选择通常的主要反应位点。）
A. C2 (CHCH₃)
B. C6 (CH₂)
explanation: 来源英文解析（待专业审校）：LDA at −78 °C removes the more accessible proton fastest and the enolates do not equilibrate: the less substituted (kinetic) enolate.
